env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local
mkdir $WORK/bin

# A loGo/s importer sees an exported const map with full const semantics.
cd m
logos build -o $WORK/bin/importcm$GOEXE ./app
exec $WORK/bin/importcm$GOEXE
stdout '^ok range-sorted$'
stdout '^ok lookup-miss$'
stdout '^ok comma-hit$'
stdout '^ok comma-miss$'
stdout '^ok len-const$'
stdout '^ok small-a-1$'
stdout '^ok big-miss$'
stdout '^ok copy-isolation$'
cp stdout $WORK/want.txt
logos eject -o out
exists out/app/main.go
exists out/lib/lib.go
cd out
go run ./app
cmp stdout $WORK/want.txt
# SPEC 0.3: ejected output builds with upstream go1.27.2 from $UPROOT1272.
exists $UPROOT1272/bin/go
exec $UPROOT1272/bin/go version
stdout '^go version go1\.27\.2 '
exec env -u GOROOT $UPROOT1272/bin/go build ./...
cd ..
# Incremental rebuild: a changed value in lib reaches the importer.
cp v2lib.lgo lib/lib.lgo
logos build -o $WORK/bin/importcm2$GOEXE ./app
exec $WORK/bin/importcm2$GOEXE
stdout '^ok small-a-100$'
stdout '^ok range-sorted$'
stdout '^ok copy-isolation$'
cd ..

# An unexported const map stays invisible to importers.
cd badhidden
! logos build ./...
stderr 'undefined: lib\.hidden'
cd ..

# Mutation of an imported const map is rejected with the const diagnostic.
cd badmut
! logos build ./...
stderr 'correctness::const_view_mutation'
cd ..

-- m/go.mod --
module example.com/cmimport

go 1.27

-- m/lib/lib.lgo --
package lib

const Small = map[string]int{"b": 2, "a": 1, "c": 3}

const Big = map[string]int{
	"k07": 7,
	"k02": 2,
	"k09": 9,
	"k00": 0,
	"k05": 5,
	"k03": 3,
	"k08": 8,
	"k01": 1,
	"k06": 6,
	"k04": 4,
}

const hidden = map[string]int{"z": 26}

-- m/app/main.lgo --
package main

import (
	"fmt"
	"os"

	"example.com/cmimport/lib"
)

//logos:zeroalloc
//go:noinline
func probeSmall(k string) int {
	return lib.Small[k] ?? -1
}

//logos:zeroalloc
//go:noinline
func probeBig(k string) (int, bool) {
	v, ok := lib.Big[k]
	return v, ok
}

const smallLen = len(lib.Small)

var _ [len(lib.Big)]int

var _ [smallLen]int

func fail(msg string) {
	fmt.Println("FAIL " + msg)
	os.Exit(1)
}

func main() {
	if gotA := probeSmall("a"); gotA != 1 && gotA != 100 {
		fail("lookup-hit")
	}
	fmt.Printf("ok small-a-%d\n", probeSmall("a"))
	if probeSmall("zz") != -1 {
		fail("lookup-miss")
	}
	fmt.Println("ok lookup-miss")
	if v, ok := lib.Small["c"]; v != 3 || !ok {
		fail("comma-hit")
	}
	fmt.Println("ok comma-hit")
	if v, ok := lib.Small["zz"]; v != 0 || ok {
		fail("comma-miss")
	}
	fmt.Println("ok comma-miss")
	if len(lib.Small) != 3 || len(lib.Big) != 10 || smallLen != 3 {
		fail("len-const")
	}
	fmt.Println("ok len-const")
	keys := ""
	sum := 0
	n := 0
	for k, v := range lib.Big {
		keys += k + ";"
		sum += v
		n++
	}
	if keys != "k00;k01;k02;k03;k04;k05;k06;k07;k08;k09;" || sum != 45 || n != 10 {
		fail("range-sorted")
	}
	fmt.Println("ok range-sorted")
	if v, ok := probeBig("k04"); v != 4 || !ok {
		fail("big-hit")
	}
	fmt.Println("ok big-hit")
	if _, ok := probeBig("zz"); ok {
		fail("big-miss")
	}
	fmt.Println("ok big-miss")
	copied := lib.Small
	copied["a"] = 999
	if probeSmall("a") != 1 && probeSmall("a") != 100 {
		fail("copy-isolation")
	}
	fmt.Println("ok copy-isolation")
}

-- m/v2lib.lgo --
package lib

const Small = map[string]int{"b": 2, "a": 100, "c": 3}

const Big = map[string]int{
	"k07": 7,
	"k02": 2,
	"k09": 9,
	"k00": 0,
	"k05": 5,
	"k03": 3,
	"k08": 8,
	"k01": 1,
	"k06": 6,
	"k04": 4,
}

const hidden = map[string]int{"z": 26}

-- badhidden/go.mod --
module example.com/cmhidden

go 1.27

-- badhidden/lib/lib.lgo --
package lib

const hidden = map[string]int{"z": 26}

-- badhidden/app/main.lgo --
package main

import (
	"fmt"

	"example.com/cmhidden/lib"
)

func main() {
	fmt.Println(lib.hidden["z"] ?? -1)
}

-- badmut/go.mod --
module example.com/cmmut

go 1.27

-- badmut/lib/lib.lgo --
package lib

const Small = map[string]int{"b": 2, "a": 1, "c": 3}

-- badmut/app/main.lgo --
package main

import (
	"fmt"

	"example.com/cmmut/lib"
)

func main() {
	lib.Small["a"] = 9
	fmt.Println(lib.Small["a"] ?? -1)
}
